world_seed.visual_direction: basalt, frosted glass, oxidized silver, signal red accents

genre: counterfactual museum, obligation auction, probability politics
premise: A museum exhibiting debts that have not yet occurred, where curators stabilize possible obligations and visitors can manifest them into reality.
simulation_objective: Manage the flow of counterfactual liability and prevent the collapse of the probability-debt market.
economy_focus: counterfactual liability trading and probability stabilization
exploration_focus: uncovering the causal origins of un-incurred debts
visual_style: Top-down pixel art with black basalt floors, frosted glass partitions, and pale mint lighting.

social_rules: Debts must be stabilized before they can be traded.
Manifestation of a debt requires a unanimous vote from the Curators.
Provenances must be verified by the Lead Archivist.
No text or logos are allowed on any museum property.
All transactions must be recorded on ceramic tallies.

conflict_hooks: The Great Collapse debt is nearing 100% probability.

A visitor is attempting to manifest a debt without a permit.
